WITH identity_lock AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT 1 AS ok
    FROM (SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1::text, 0))) l
),
existing AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT slot_no, execution_id, expires_at
    FROM topic_slots
    WHERE post_id = $1
      AND expires_at > now()
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_lock)
    FOR UPDATE
),
renewed AS (
    UPDATE topic_slots
    SET expires_at = now() + make_interval(mins => $3::int)
    WHERE slot_no = (
        SELECT slot_no FROM existing WHERE execution_id = $2 LIMIT 1
    )
    RETURNING slot_no, expires_at
),
claimed AS (
    UPDATE topic_slots
    SET post_id = $1,
        execution_id = $2,
        locked_at = now(),
        expires_at = now() + make_interval(mins => $3::int)
    WHERE slot_no = (
        SELECT slot_no
        FROM topic_slots
        WHERE (post_id IS NULL OR expires_at <= now())
          AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
        ORDER BY slot_no
        LIMIT 1
        FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    )
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM identity_lock) = 1
    RETURNING slot_no, expires_at
)
SELECT $1::text AS post_id, slot_no, expires_at, 'renewed' AS lock_state FROM renewed
UNION ALL
SELECT $1::text, slot_no, expires_at, 'acquired' FROM claimed
UNION ALL
SELECT $1::text, slot_no, expires_at, 'locked_by_other'
FROM existing
WHERE execution_id IS DISTINCT FROM $2
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM renewed)
UNION ALL
SELECT $1::text, NULL, NULL, 'all_slots_busy'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM renewed)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM claimed)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)

WITH ledger AS (
  INSERT INTO cost_ledger (idempotency_key, post_id, execution_id, content_id, step, provider, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, pricing_version, usage_type)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::int, $9::int, $10::numeric, $11, $12)
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, cost_usd
),
budget AS (
  INSERT INTO topic_budget AS tb (post_id, budget_usd, spent_usd, warning_sent, exceeded_sent, alert_now, updated_at)
  SELECT $2, 0.50, l.cost_usd,
    l.cost_usd >= 0.8 * 0.50,
    l.cost_usd >= 0.50,
    CASE WHEN l.cost_usd >= 0.50 THEN 'exceeded' WHEN l.cost_usd >= 0.8 * 0.50 THEN 'warning' ELSE NULL END,
    now()
  FROM ledger l
  ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO UPDATE SET
    spent_usd = tb.spent_usd + EXCLUDED.spent_usd,
    alert_now = CASE
      WHEN tb.spent_usd + EXCLUDED.spent_usd >= tb.budget_usd AND NOT tb.exceeded_sent THEN 'exceeded'
      WHEN tb.spent_usd + EXCLUDED.spent_usd >= 0.8 * tb.budget_usd AND NOT tb.warning_sent AND NOT tb.exceeded_sent THEN 'warning'
      ELSE NULL END,
    warning_sent = tb.warning_sent OR tb.spent_usd + EXCLUDED.spent_usd >= 0.8 * tb.budget_usd,
    exceeded_sent = tb.exceeded_sent OR tb.spent_usd + EXCLUDED.spent_usd >= tb.budget_usd,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING tb.post_id, tb.budget_usd, tb.spent_usd, tb.alert_now
),
unchanged AS (
  SELECT tb.post_id, tb.budget_usd, tb.spent_usd, NULL::text AS alert_now
  FROM topic_budget tb
  WHERE tb.post_id = $2
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger)
),
no_budget_row AS (
  SELECT $2::text AS post_id, 0.50::numeric AS budget_usd, 0::numeric AS spent_usd, NULL::text AS alert_now
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unchanged)
),
b AS (
  SELECT * FROM budget
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM unchanged
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM no_budget_row
)
SELECT b.post_id,
  b.budget_usd::float AS budget_usd,
  b.spent_usd::float AS spent_usd,
  round(b.spent_usd / NULLIF(b.budget_usd, 0) * 100, 1)::float AS budget_used_pct,
  CASE WHEN b.spent_usd >= b.budget_usd THEN 'exceeded' WHEN b.spent_usd >= 0.8 * b.budget_usd THEN 'warning' ELSE 'ok' END AS budget_status,
  COALESCE(b.alert_now, '') AS alert_level,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger) AS new_charge,
  $1::text AS idempotency_key,
  COALESCE((SELECT id FROM ledger), (SELECT id FROM cost_ledger WHERE idempotency_key = $1 LIMIT 1)) AS ledger_id
FROM b

SELECT $1::text AS post_id,
  COALESCE(tb.budget_usd, 0.50)::float AS budget_usd,
  COALESCE(tb.spent_usd, 0)::float AS spent_usd,
  round(COALESCE(tb.spent_usd, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(tb.budget_usd, 0.50), 0) * 100, 1)::float AS budget_used_pct,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(tb.spent_usd, 0) >= COALESCE(tb.budget_usd, 0.50) THEN 'exceeded'
    WHEN COALESCE(tb.spent_usd, 0) >= 0.8 * COALESCE(tb.budget_usd, 0.50) THEN 'warning'
    ELSE 'ok'
  END AS budget_status
FROM (SELECT 1) d
LEFT JOIN topic_budget tb ON tb.post_id = $1

WITH released AS (
    UPDATE topic_slots
    SET post_id = NULL,
        execution_id = NULL,
        locked_at = NULL,
        expires_at = NULL
    WHERE post_id = $1
      AND execution_id = $2
    RETURNING slot_no
),
not_owned_audit AS (
    INSERT INTO audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, actor, old_status, new_status, details, workflow_name, execution_id)
    SELECT 'topic', $1, 'lock_release_not_owned', 'system', NULL, NULL,
           jsonb_build_object('requested_by_execution', $2::text, 'note', 'No lock owned by this execution was found, so nothing was released'),
           'LinkedIn Content - DB Gateway', $2
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM released)
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT $1::text AS post_id,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM released)::int AS released_slots,
       EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM released) AS released,
       NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM released) AS ownership_mismatch,
       (SELECT id FROM not_owned_audit) AS mismatch_audit_id

INSERT INTO audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, actor, old_status, new_status, details, workflow_name, execution_id)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, COALESCE($7::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), $8, $9)
RETURNING id AS audit_id, created_at

WITH t AS (
  INSERT INTO topics AS x (post_id, topic, destination, language, content_pillar, priority, notes, status, sources_found, research_attempts, last_error, created_at, updated_at)
  SELECT r.post_id, r.topic, r.destination, r.language, r.content_pillar, r.priority, r.notes, r.status, r.sources_found, r.research_attempts, r.last_error, now(), now()
  FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::topics, $2::jsonb) r
  WHERE $1 = 'topic'
  ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO UPDATE SET
    topic = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'topic') THEN EXCLUDED.topic ELSE x.topic END,
    destination = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'destination') THEN EXCLUDED.destination ELSE x.destination END,
    language = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'language') THEN EXCLUDED.language ELSE x.language END,
    content_pillar = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'content_pillar') THEN EXCLUDED.content_pillar ELSE x.content_pillar END,
    priority = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'priority') THEN EXCLUDED.priority ELSE x.priority END,
    notes = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'notes') THEN EXCLUDED.notes ELSE x.notes END,
    status = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'status') THEN EXCLUDED.status ELSE x.status END,
    sources_found = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'sources_found') THEN EXCLUDED.sources_found ELSE x.sources_found END,
    research_attempts = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'research_attempts') THEN EXCLUDED.research_attempts ELSE x.research_attempts END,
    last_error = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'last_error') THEN EXCLUDED.last_error ELSE x.last_error END,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING x.post_id AS record_id
),
c AS (
  INSERT INTO content_versions AS y (content_id, post_id, version, parent_content_id, destination, language, variation_label, post_text, char_count, status, risk_level, admin_approval_required, risk_notes, risk_flags, risk_hash, risk_checked_at, risk_review_status, approval_eligible, verification_required, status_note, created_at, updated_at)
  SELECT r.content_id, r.post_id, r.version, r.parent_content_id, r.destination, r.language, r.variation_label, r.post_text, r.char_count, r.status, r.risk_level, COALESCE(r.admin_approval_required, false), r.risk_notes, r.risk_flags, r.risk_hash, r.risk_checked_at, r.risk_review_status,
    COALESCE(r.approval_eligible, false) AND COALESCE(r.status, '') <> 'Needs Human Verification' AND COALESCE(r.risk_review_status, '') <> 'Needs Human Verification',
    COALESCE(r.status, '') = 'Needs Human Verification' OR COALESCE(r.risk_review_status, '') = 'Needs Human Verification',
    r.status_note, now(), now()
  FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::content_versions, $2::jsonb) r
  WHERE $1 = 'content'
  ON CONFLICT (content_id) DO UPDATE SET
    post_id = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'post_id') THEN EXCLUDED.post_id ELSE y.post_id END,
    version = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'version') THEN EXCLUDED.version ELSE y.version END,
    parent_content_id = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'parent_content_id') THEN EXCLUDED.parent_content_id ELSE y.parent_content_id END,
    destination = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'destination') THEN EXCLUDED.destination ELSE y.destination END,
    language = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'language') THEN EXCLUDED.language ELSE y.language END,
    variation_label = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'variation_label') THEN EXCLUDED.variation_label ELSE y.variation_label END,
    post_text = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'post_text') THEN EXCLUDED.post_text ELSE y.post_text END,
    char_count = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'char_count') THEN EXCLUDED.char_count ELSE y.char_count END,
    status = CASE WHEN y.status = 'Needs Human Verification' THEN y.status WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'status') THEN EXCLUDED.status ELSE y.status END,
    risk_level = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'risk_level') THEN EXCLUDED.risk_level ELSE y.risk_level END,
    admin_approval_required = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'admin_approval_required') THEN EXCLUDED.admin_approval_required ELSE y.admin_approval_required END,
    risk_notes = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'risk_notes') THEN EXCLUDED.risk_notes ELSE y.risk_notes END,
    risk_flags = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'risk_flags') THEN EXCLUDED.risk_flags ELSE y.risk_flags END,
    risk_hash = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'risk_hash') THEN EXCLUDED.risk_hash ELSE y.risk_hash END,
    risk_checked_at = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'risk_checked_at') THEN EXCLUDED.risk_checked_at ELSE y.risk_checked_at END,
    risk_review_status = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'risk_review_status') THEN EXCLUDED.risk_review_status ELSE y.risk_review_status END,
    approval_eligible = CASE WHEN y.status = 'Needs Human Verification' OR EXCLUDED.verification_required THEN false WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'approval_eligible') THEN EXCLUDED.approval_eligible ELSE y.approval_eligible END,
    verification_required = y.verification_required OR EXCLUDED.verification_required,
    status_note = CASE WHEN jsonb_exists($2::jsonb, 'status_note') THEN EXCLUDED.status_note ELSE y.status_note END,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE y.approved_hash IS NULL
    AND y.published_at IS NULL
    AND y.superseded_by IS NULL
    AND y.reviewer_user_id IS NULL
    AND y.verified_by_user_id IS NULL
    AND COALESCE(y.reviewer_decision, '') = ''
    AND COALESCE(y.status, '') IN ('', 'Draft', 'Pending Review', 'Needs Human Verification', 'Validation Failed', 'Generation Failed', 'Persistence Failed')
  RETURNING y.content_id AS record_id
)
SELECT $1::text AS entity,
  COALESCE((SELECT record_id FROM t LIMIT 1), (SELECT record_id FROM c LIMIT 1)) AS record_id,
  ((SELECT count(*) FROM t) + (SELECT count(*) FROM c))::int AS rows_written,
  ((SELECT count(*) FROM t) + (SELECT count(*) FROM c)) > 0 AS success,
  CASE WHEN ((SELECT count(*) FROM t) + (SELECT count(*) FROM c)) = 0 THEN 'Record is past draft stage (verified, decided, approved, superseded or publishing) - use the purpose-specific action' ELSE '' END AS blocked_reason

WITH cur AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT cv.*, encode(sha256(convert_to(COALESCE(cv.post_text, ''), 'UTF8')), 'hex') AS live_hash
  FROM content_versions cv
  WHERE cv.content_id = $1
  FOR UPDATE
),
actor AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT u.user_id, bool_or(a.can_self_approve) AS can_self_approve
  FROM users u
  JOIN user_role_assignments a ON a.user_id = u.user_id AND a.active
  JOIN cur ON a.destination IN (cur.destination, 'Both')
  WHERE u.user_id = $5
    AND u.active
    AND (a.role = $2::text OR ($2::text = 'verification' AND a.role IN ('verifier', 'admin')))
  GROUP BY u.user_id
),
prior AS (
  SELECT id FROM approval_events WHERE idempotency_key = $10
),
chk AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT cur.content_id, cur.version, cur.status AS old_status, cur.live_hash,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM prior) THEN 'duplicate'
      WHEN cur.content_id IS NULL THEN 'not_found'
      WHEN cur.superseded_by IS NOT NULL OR cur.status = 'Superseded' THEN 'superseded'
      WHEN cur.live_hash <> $4::text THEN 'hash_mismatch'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM actor) THEN 'actor_not_authorized'
      WHEN $2::text = 'verification' AND cur.status <> 'Needs Human Verification' THEN 'invalid_transition'
      WHEN $2::text = 'reviewer' AND cur.status <> 'Pending Review' THEN 'invalid_transition'
      WHEN $2::text = 'publisher' AND cur.status <> 'Reviewer Approved' THEN 'invalid_transition'
      WHEN $2::text = 'admin' AND cur.status <> 'Awaiting Admin Approval' THEN 'invalid_transition'
      WHEN $2::text = 'reviewer' AND $3::text = 'approved' AND NOT cur.approval_eligible THEN 'not_approval_eligible'
      WHEN $2::text <> 'verification' AND $3::text IN ('approved', 'authorized') AND cur.verification_required
           AND (cur.verification_outcome IS DISTINCT FROM 'Verified' OR cur.verified_hash IS DISTINCT FROM cur.live_hash) THEN 'human_verification_required'
      WHEN $2::text IN ('publisher', 'admin') AND $5::text IN (COALESCE(cur.reviewer_user_id, ''), COALESCE(cur.publisher_user_id, ''))
           AND NOT COALESCE((SELECT can_self_approve FROM actor), false) THEN 'self_approval_blocked'
      WHEN $2::text IN ('publisher', 'admin') AND char_length(COALESCE(cur.post_text, '')) > 1250 THEN 'over_character_limit'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END AS outcome,
    CASE
      WHEN $2::text = 'verification' AND $3::text = 'verified' THEN 'Pending Review'
      WHEN $2::text = 'reviewer' AND $3::text = 'approved' THEN 'Reviewer Approved'
      WHEN $2::text = 'reviewer' AND $3::text = 'revision_requested' THEN 'Revision Requested'
      WHEN $2::text = 'publisher' AND $3::text = 'authorized' AND cur.admin_approval_required THEN 'Awaiting Admin Approval'
      WHEN $2::text = 'publisher' AND $3::text = 'authorized' THEN 'Approved - Ready to Schedule'
      WHEN $2::text = 'admin' AND $3::text = 'approved' THEN 'Approved - Ready to Schedule'
      ELSE 'Rejected'
    END AS next_status
  FROM (SELECT 1) d
  LEFT JOIN cur ON true
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE content_versions cv SET
    status = chk.next_status,
    approval_eligible = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'verification' AND $3::text = 'verified' THEN true ELSE cv.approval_eligible END,
    verified_by_user_id = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'verification' THEN $5::text ELSE cv.verified_by_user_id END,
    verified_at = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'verification' THEN now() ELSE cv.verified_at END,
    verification_notes = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'verification' THEN $6::text ELSE cv.verification_notes END,
    verification_evidence = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'verification' THEN COALESCE($7::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb) ELSE cv.verification_evidence END,
    verified_hash = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'verification' THEN chk.live_hash ELSE cv.verified_hash END,
    verification_outcome = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'verification' THEN $12::text ELSE cv.verification_outcome END,
    reviewer_user_id = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'reviewer' THEN $5::text ELSE cv.reviewer_user_id END,
    reviewer_decision = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'reviewer' THEN $12::text ELSE cv.reviewer_decision END,
    reviewer_notes = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'reviewer' THEN $6::text ELSE cv.reviewer_notes END,
    reviewer_at = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'reviewer' THEN now() ELSE cv.reviewer_at END,
    publisher_user_id = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'publisher' THEN $5::text ELSE cv.publisher_user_id END,
    publisher_authorization = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'publisher' THEN $12::text ELSE cv.publisher_authorization END,
    publisher_at = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'publisher' THEN now() ELSE cv.publisher_at END,
    admin_user_id = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'admin' THEN $5::text ELSE cv.admin_user_id END,
    admin_approval = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'admin' THEN $12::text ELSE cv.admin_approval END,
    admin_at = CASE WHEN $2::text = 'admin' THEN now() ELSE cv.admin_at END,
    approved_hash = CASE WHEN chk.next_status = 'Approved - Ready to Schedule' THEN chk.live_hash ELSE cv.approved_hash END,
    approved_version = CASE WHEN chk.next_status = 'Approved - Ready to Schedule' THEN cv.version ELSE cv.approved_version END,
    approved_at = CASE WHEN chk.next_status = 'Approved - Ready to Schedule' THEN now() ELSE cv.approved_at END,
    updated_at = now()
  FROM chk
  WHERE cv.content_id = chk.content_id
    AND chk.outcome = 'ok'
  RETURNING cv.content_id
),
ev AS (
  INSERT INTO approval_events (idempotency_key, content_id, version, content_hash, stage, decision, actor_user_id, actor_channel, notes, evidence, old_status, new_status, execution_id, workflow_name)
  SELECT $10, chk.content_id, chk.version, chk.live_hash, $2, $12, $5, $11, $6, COALESCE($7::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), chk.old_status, chk.next_status, $8, $9
  FROM chk
  WHERE chk.outcome = 'ok'
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
),
aud AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, actor, old_status, new_status, details, workflow_name, execution_id)
  SELECT 'content', $1, $2::text || CASE WHEN chk.outcome = 'ok' THEN '_decision' ELSE '_decision_refused' END, $5, chk.old_status,
    CASE WHEN chk.outcome = 'ok' THEN chk.next_status ELSE chk.old_status END,
    jsonb_build_object('decision', $12::text, 'outcome', chk.outcome, 'content_hash', $4::text, 'actor_channel', $11::text),
    $9, $8
  FROM chk
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT $1::text AS content_id,
  $2::text AS stage,
  chk.outcome,
  chk.outcome IN ('ok', 'duplicate') AS success,
  chk.outcome = 'duplicate' AS duplicate,
  chk.old_status,
  CASE WHEN chk.outcome = 'ok' THEN chk.next_status ELSE chk.old_status END AS new_status,
  CASE WHEN chk.outcome = 'ok' AND chk.next_status = 'Approved - Ready to Schedule' THEN chk.live_hash END AS approved_hash,
  (SELECT id FROM ev) AS approval_event_id,
  (SELECT id FROM aud) AS audit_id
FROM chk

WITH old AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT cv.*, encode(sha256(convert_to(COALESCE(cv.post_text, ''), 'UTF8')), 'hex') AS live_hash
  FROM content_versions cv
  WHERE cv.content_id = $1
  FOR UPDATE
),
nr AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::content_versions, $3::jsonb)
),
actor AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT u.user_id
  FROM users u
  JOIN user_role_assignments a ON a.user_id = u.user_id AND a.active AND a.role IN ('reviewer', 'admin')
  JOIN old ON a.destination IN (old.destination, 'Both')
  WHERE u.user_id = $4
    AND u.active
  LIMIT 1
),
chk AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT old.content_id AS old_id, old.status AS old_status, nr.content_id AS new_id,
    (COALESCE(old.verification_required, false) OR COALESCE(nr.status, '') = 'Needs Human Verification' OR COALESCE(nr.risk_review_status, '') = 'Needs Human Verification') AS needs_verification,
    CASE
      WHEN old.content_id IS NULL THEN 'not_found'
      WHEN old.superseded_by IS NOT NULL OR old.status = 'Superseded' THEN 'already_superseded'
      WHEN old.published_at IS NOT NULL OR old.status IN ('Publishing', 'Published', 'Reconciliation Required') THEN 'locked_for_publishing'
      WHEN old.live_hash <> $2::text THEN 'hash_mismatch'
      WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM actor) THEN 'actor_not_authorized'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_versions x WHERE x.content_id = nr.content_id) THEN 'new_content_id_exists'
      WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_versions x WHERE x.parent_content_id = old.content_id) THEN 'revision_already_exists'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END AS outcome
  FROM (SELECT 1) d
  LEFT JOIN old ON true
  LEFT JOIN nr ON true
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO content_versions (content_id, post_id, version, parent_content_id, destination, language, variation_label, post_text, char_count, status, risk_level, admin_approval_required, risk_notes, risk_flags, risk_hash, risk_checked_at, risk_review_status, approval_eligible, verification_required, status_note, created_at, updated_at)
  SELECT nr.content_id, old.post_id, COALESCE(old.version, 1) + 1, old.content_id, old.destination, old.language, old.variation_label,
    nr.post_text, char_length(nr.post_text),
    CASE WHEN chk.needs_verification THEN 'Needs Human Verification' ELSE 'Pending Review' END,
    nr.risk_level,
    COALESCE(nr.admin_approval_required, false) OR COALESCE(old.admin_approval_required, false),
    nr.risk_notes, nr.risk_flags, nr.risk_hash, nr.risk_checked_at, nr.risk_review_status,
    COALESCE(nr.approval_eligible, false) AND NOT chk.needs_verification,
    chk.needs_verification,
    COALESCE(nr.status_note, 'Revision of ' || old.content_id),
    now(), now()
  FROM old CROSS JOIN nr CROSS JOIN chk
  WHERE chk.outcome = 'ok'
  RETURNING content_id, version, status
),
sup AS (
  UPDATE content_versions cv
  SET status = 'Superseded',
      superseded_by = (SELECT content_id FROM ins),
      status_note = 'Replaced by ' || (SELECT content_id FROM ins),
      updated_at = now()
  WHERE cv.content_id = $1
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)
  RETURNING cv.content_id
),
aud AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, actor, old_status, new_status, details, workflow_name, execution_id)
  SELECT 'content', $1, CASE WHEN chk.outcome = 'ok' THEN 'revision_created' ELSE 'revision_refused' END, $4, chk.old_status,
    CASE WHEN chk.outcome = 'ok' THEN 'Superseded' ELSE chk.old_status END,
    jsonb_build_object('outcome', chk.outcome, 'new_content_id', chk.new_id, 'previous_hash', $2::text, 'change_summary', $7::text, 'approvals_reset', chk.outcome = 'ok'),
    $6, $5
  FROM chk
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT $1::text AS old_content_id,
  chk.new_id AS new_content_id,
  chk.outcome,
  chk.outcome = 'ok' AS success,
  (SELECT version FROM ins) AS new_version,
  (SELECT status FROM ins) AS new_status,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sup) AS old_superseded,
  (SELECT id FROM aud) AS audit_id
FROM chk

WITH ctl AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT COALESCE((SELECT paused FROM publishing_controls WHERE id = 1), true) AS paused
),
dest_busy AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM publishing_attempts WHERE destination = $1 AND status = 'Publishing') AS busy
),
cand AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT cv.content_id, cv.version, cv.post_id, cv.destination, cv.language, cv.post_text, cv.status, cv.approved_hash, cv.scheduled_for
  FROM content_versions cv
  WHERE cv.destination = $1
    AND NOT (SELECT paused FROM ctl)
    AND NOT (SELECT busy FROM dest_busy)
    AND cv.status IN ('Approved - Ready to Schedule', 'Scheduled')
    AND (cv.scheduled_for IS NULL OR cv.scheduled_for <= now())
    AND cv.superseded_by IS NULL
    AND cv.published_at IS NULL
    AND cv.approval_eligible
    AND cv.approved_version = cv.version
    AND cv.approved_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to(COALESCE(cv.post_text, ''), 'UTF8')), 'hex')
    AND cv.reviewer_user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND cv.publisher_user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (NOT cv.admin_approval_required OR cv.admin_user_id IS NOT NULL)
    AND (NOT cv.verification_required OR (cv.verification_outcome = 'Verified' AND cv.verified_hash = cv.approved_hash))
    AND char_length(COALESCE(cv.post_text, '')) BETWEEN 1 AND 1250
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM publishing_attempts pa
      WHERE pa.content_id = cv.content_id
        AND pa.status IN ('Publishing', 'Unknown - Reconciliation Required', 'Published')
    )
  ORDER BY cv.scheduled_for NULLS LAST, cv.approved_at, cv.content_id
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
),
att AS (
  INSERT INTO publishing_attempts (content_id, version, destination, execution_id, request_hash, slot_label, status, claimed_at, updated_at)
  SELECT content_id, version, destination, $2, approved_hash, $3, 'Publishing', now(), now()
  FROM cand
  RETURNING attempt_id, content_id
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE content_versions cv
  SET status = 'Publishing', updated_at = now()
  FROM att
  WHERE cv.content_id = att.content_id
  RETURNING cv.content_id
),
aud AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, actor, old_status, new_status, details, workflow_name, execution_id)
  SELECT 'content', cand.content_id, 'publish_claimed', 'system', cand.status, 'Publishing',
    jsonb_build_object('attempt_id', att.attempt_id, 'slot', $3::text, 'destination', $1::text, 'content_hash', cand.approved_hash),
    $4, $2
  FROM cand
  JOIN att ON att.content_id = cand.content_id
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT $1::text AS destination,
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM att) AS claimed,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT paused FROM ctl) THEN 'publishing_paused'
    WHEN (SELECT busy FROM dest_busy) THEN 'destination_busy'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM att) THEN 'claimed'
    ELSE 'no_eligible_content'
  END AS claim_state,
  (SELECT attempt_id::text FROM att) AS attempt_id,
  cand.content_id,
  cand.post_id,
  cand.version,
  cand.language,
  cand.post_text,
  cand.approved_hash AS content_hash,
  cand.scheduled_for
FROM (SELECT 1) d
LEFT JOIN cand ON true

WITH att AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT * FROM publishing_attempts WHERE attempt_id = $1::uuid FOR UPDATE
),
chk AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT att.attempt_id, att.content_id, att.status AS old_status,
    CASE
      WHEN att.attempt_id IS NULL THEN 'not_found'
      WHEN att.execution_id IS DISTINCT FROM $2::text THEN 'ownership_mismatch'
      WHEN att.status = 'Published' AND $3::text = 'published' AND att.linkedin_urn = $4::text THEN 'duplicate'
      WHEN att.status <> 'Publishing' THEN 'invalid_transition'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END AS outcome,
    CASE $3::text WHEN 'published' THEN 'Published' WHEN 'failed' THEN 'Failed' ELSE 'Unknown - Reconciliation Required' END AS attempt_status,
    CASE $3::text WHEN 'published' THEN 'Published' WHEN 'failed' THEN 'Publish Failed' ELSE 'Reconciliation Required' END AS content_status
  FROM (SELECT 1) d
  LEFT JOIN att ON true
),
ua AS (
  UPDATE publishing_attempts pa
  SET status = chk.attempt_status,
      linkedin_urn = $4,
      post_url = $5,
      error_details = $6,
      finished_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
  FROM chk
  WHERE pa.attempt_id = chk.attempt_id
    AND chk.outcome = 'ok'
  RETURNING pa.attempt_id
),
uc AS (
  UPDATE content_versions cv
  SET status = chk.content_status,
      published_at = CASE WHEN $3::text = 'published' THEN now() ELSE cv.published_at END,
      linkedin_urn = CASE WHEN $3::text = 'published' THEN $4::text ELSE cv.linkedin_urn END,
      post_url = CASE WHEN $3::text = 'published' THEN $5::text ELSE cv.post_url END,
      status_note = CASE $3::text
        WHEN 'published' THEN 'Published'
        WHEN 'failed' THEN left('Publish failed (LinkedIn refused): ' || COALESCE($6::text, ''), 500)
        ELSE 'Outcome unknown - do not retry until reconciled against LinkedIn'
      END,
      updated_at = now()
  FROM chk
  WHERE cv.content_id = chk.content_id
    AND chk.outcome = 'ok'
  RETURNING cv.status
),
aud AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, actor, old_status, new_status, details, workflow_name, execution_id)
  SELECT 'content', COALESCE(chk.content_id, $1::text), CASE WHEN chk.outcome = 'ok' THEN 'publish_' || $3::text ELSE 'publish_result_refused' END, 'system',
    chk.old_status, CASE WHEN chk.outcome = 'ok' THEN chk.attempt_status ELSE chk.old_status END,
    jsonb_build_object('attempt_id', $1::text, 'outcome', chk.outcome, 'linkedin_urn', $4::text, 'error', $6::text),
    $7, $2
  FROM chk
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT $1::text AS attempt_id,
  chk.content_id,
  chk.outcome,
  chk.outcome IN ('ok', 'duplicate') AS success,
  chk.outcome = 'duplicate' AS duplicate,
  CASE WHEN chk.outcome = 'ok' THEN chk.attempt_status ELSE chk.old_status END AS attempt_status,
  (SELECT status FROM uc) AS content_status,
  ($3::text = 'unknown' AND chk.outcome = 'ok') AS reconciliation_required,
  (SELECT id FROM aud) AS audit_id
FROM chk

nodeGroups.name: Check the request
nodeGroups.description: Rejects unknown actions, missing owner IDs and attempts to write approval or publishing fields before anything touches the database

nodeGroups.name: Claim topic slot
nodeGroups.description: One claim per topic at a time: renews the caller's own lock, refuses locks held by others, or reports all 3 slots busy

nodeGroups.name: Track topic budget
nodeGroups.description: Records each charge once per idempotency key, then warns once at 80% and once at 100% of the topic budget

nodeGroups.name: Report budget status
nodeGroups.description: Lets a caller ask, before a paid AI call, whether the topic is still within budget, without recording a charge

nodeGroups.name: Record state changes
nodeGroups.description: Lock release, audit, draft sync, role-checked decisions on exact text, versioning that resets approvals, atomic publish claims
